import subprocess
code="import json,subprocess,socket,ssl,hashlib
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
r={'task':'VivoAPK multiplatform TLS diagnostic','read_only':True,'media_requested':False,'credentials_opened':False}
try:
 p=subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','-u','postgres','/usr/bin/psql','-X','-A','-t','-F','|','-d','vivoapk','-c','SELECT username,dns_link,dns_link_samsung_lg FROM subscription_mappings LIMIT 500;'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=12)
 if p.returncode!=0: raise RuntimeError('mapping_read_denied')
 match=[v for line in p.stdout.splitlines() if (v:=line.split('|')) and len(v)>=3 and hashlib.sha256(v[0].casefold().encode()).hexdigest()=='27f3817eb2ec39d1e4967bd07f2dea3d37f114cb0dae3f22df09ec398a8ccb38']
 if len(match)!=1: raise RuntimeError('test_account_not_unique')
 for label,value in [('general',match[0][1]),('smart_tv',match[0][2])]:
  z={'configured':bool(value and value!='NULL')}
  if not z['configured']:r[label]=z;continue
  parsed=urlsplit(value.strip())
  if parsed.scheme not in ('http','https') or not parsed.hostname:raise RuntimeError('provider_origin_invalid')
  z['configured_scheme']=parsed.scheme
  z['dns_ends_with_root']=parsed.path in ('','/')
  try:
   with socket.create_connection((parsed.hostname,443),timeout=5) as raw:
    z['tcp_443']=True
    with ssl.create_default_context().wrap_socket(raw,server_hostname=parsed.hostname) as tls:
     z['tls_certificate_valid']=True
     z['tls_version']=tls.version()
  except Exception as e:
   z['tcp_443']=z.get('tcp_443',False)
   z['tls_certificate_valid']=False
   z['tls_failure_class']=type(e).__name__
  r[label]=z
 with socket.create_connection(('serveriptv.duckdns.org',443),timeout=5) as raw:
  with ssl.create_default_context().wrap_socket(raw,server_hostname='serveriptv.duckdns.org') as conn:
   r['jellyfin_https_tls_valid']=True
 r['status']='checked'
except Exception as e:r['status']='blocked';r['blocker']=str(e) if isinstance(e,RuntimeError) else type(e).__name__
print(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
"
p=subprocess.run(['sudo','-n','/srv/projects/Vivoapk/.venv/bin/python','-c',code],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=34)
print(p.stdout[:4000] if p.stdout else 'NO_TLS_DIAGNOSTIC_RESULT',flush=True)
print('TLS_PROBE_EXIT='+str(p.returncode),flush=True)
